jobs.title: Production Engineer (SRE/Dev - Python)
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Production Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Manager, Site Reliability Engineering in the Cloud Infrastructure & Operations department. Join Zscaler to be a force multiplier for the reliability of a global platform protecting over 15 million users, providing the technical vision and hands-on execution to drive an automation-first culture across the company. By maturing our observability and architectural standards, you will directly reduce our Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and shape the scalability of our globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure.

What you'll do (Role Expectations)

* Design and implement highly available, scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and bare-metal environments
* Drive an "automation-first" culture by writing code (Python/Go) to eliminate manual toil and build self-healing systems
* Implement and maintain sophisticated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), define SLIs/SLOs, and establish error budgets
* Act as a lead Incident Commander (TDO on-call), develop response playbooks, and conduct deep-dive post-incident analyses
* Partner with Engineering and partner teams to conduct operability reviews

Who You Are (Success Profile)

* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and dynamic environments, viewing uncertainty not as a hindrance but as an opportunity to build meaningful solutions.
* Driven by a strong sense of ownership and bias for action, operating with integrity while seamlessly balancing high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution.
* Laser-focused problem solver who proactively runs toward complex engineering challenges to deliver high-impact results.
* High-trust collaborator committed to team success, actively giving and receiving transparent feedback with clarity and respect.
* Purpose-driven learner with an active growth mindset, continuously seeking feedback to grow as a teammate and engineering partner.

What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 2 to 3 years of experience managing reliability, scalability, and availability for large-scale production services with deep expertise in programming (e.g., Python, Go, or C/C++)
* Strong background in networking protocols, Linux/FreeBSD systems, and distributed architecture
* Experience in high-stakes incident management and participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation
* Proficiency in leveraging ITIL frameworks and incident data to drive service maturity through systematic problem management and technical operability reviews

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

* Proven ability to leverage AI technologies, workflows, and AIOps tools to drive measurable operational efficiency, including implementing machine lear

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer (Linux Platforms)
jobs.description:
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
  
  
**Why we need this role**
The Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, automates, tests and operates secure Linux-based infrastructure supporting critical telecommunications network services. Working from agreed architectural and engineering standards, the role deploys and maintains platforms supporting DNS, routing, identity, authentication, monitoring, observability and network-management capabilities.
  
  
The Engineer is responsible for reliable implementation, infrastructure automation, lifecycle maintenance, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous improvement. The role works across Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations and progressively develops ownership of defined platforms and services.
  
  
The role supports a distributed estate of hundreds of Linux systems across critical network, security, operational and business services.
  
  
**Platforms and Services**
The team designs, deploys, automates and maintains Linux infrastructure supporting:
  
  

* Authoritative, recursive and caching DNS services.
* Route reflectors and other routing control-plane services.
* Authentication, authorisation and accounting services.
* Identity management, directory and privileged-access integrations.
* Network observability, telemetry, logging and monitoring platforms.
* Network-management and automation services.
* Virtualised and, where appropriate, containerised infrastructure.
* Supporting services such as NTP, PKI, certificate management, secure repositories and configuration services.

**What You Will Do**
**Platform Engineering and Delivery**

* Build, configure, test and maintain Linux platforms using distributions such as RHEL and Ubuntu.
* Implement infrastructure from approved architecture, high-level designs, low-level designs and engineering standards.
* Execute platform deployments, upgrades, migrations, patching and decommissioning activities.
* Maintain accurate configuration, asset, dependency and lifecycle records.
* Participate in design reviews and identify practical improvements to platform standards and implementation approaches.

**Network-Critical Services**

* Deploy and maintain DNS platforms and support resolution, delegation, availability and security troubleshooting.
* Build and maintain Linux hosts supporting route reflectors and other routing control-plane services under approved network designs.
* Deploy and support authentication, authorisation, accounting, identity and directory services, including Red Hat and Oracle LDAP environments.
* Implement and maintain network observability, telemetry, logging, monitoring and network-management platforms.

**Automation and Efficiency**

* Develop and maintain automation using Ansible, Bash or Python and infrastructure-as-code principles.
* Identify repetitive operational activities and implement approved automation to reduce manual effort and error.
* Maintain consistent, reusable configuration and build standards across environments.

**Operations, Reliability and Lifecycle**

* Monitor platform service health, performance, capacity, availability and resilience.
* Implement health checks, dashboards, logs and actionable alerts as part of each platform deployment.
* Investigate incidents and alerts, contribute to root-cause analysis and implement agreed corrective actions.
* Test backup, restoration, failover and recovery procedures and record the results.
* Support platform currency, vulnerability remediation, upgrade and obsolescence plans.

**Security and Compliance**

* Implement and validate platform hardening in line with approved standards, including CIS-aligned controls where applicable.
* Maintain vulnerability remediation, access controls, secrets, keys, certificates and centralised audit logging.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**Network Engineer**
Global Network Services is seeking a Network Engineer with a strong interest in network automation to help build and operate S&P Global's multi-cloud network platform. This role is central to our drive to replace manual network provisioning with repeatable, code-driven delivery across AWS, Azure and GCP. You will write and extend automation, implement cloud network changes, and support the platform in production - working alongside senior engineers who will guide you on design decisions and review your work. This role suits an engineer who enjoys both writing code and understanding the network it configures, and who wants to grow their cloud networking depth in a large and varied environment.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Network Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code**

* Write, test and maintain Terraform modules to provision cloud network services across AWS, Azure and GCP, working to patterns set by the senior engineering team.
* Build scripts and tooling in Python and Ansible to remove repetitive manual network tasks and improve consistency.
* Extend existing automation to cover new network services and use cases, and help keep shared modules current as cloud platforms evolve.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for network change, including automated validation and pre-deployment testing.
* Help develop automated configuration and compliance checks so deviations from approved standards are detected early.
* Follow good engineering practice in shared repositories - version control, peer review, readable modular code and clear documentation.
* Identify manual tasks in your own work that could be automated, and propose them to the team.

**Cloud and Hybrid Networking**

* Implement and support cloud network solutions across AWS, Azure and GCP based on agreed designs and requirements.
* Configure and maintain core cloud networking components including VPCs and VNets, subnets, Transit Gateway attachments, VPC peering, route tables, security groups, load balancers and DNS.
* Support hybrid connectivity across AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute and site-to-site VPN.
* Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate and resolve issues, escalating to senior engineers where appropriate.
* Apply routing fundamentals including BGP and OSPF when supporting connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments.
* Prepare and execute approved network changes within agreed maintenance windows, including documented back-out steps.

**Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work with application, security and infrastructure colleagues to deliver network changes that meet enterprise standards and compliance requirements.
* Produce and maintain low-level documentation, automation runbooks and standard operating procedures.
* Provide support to operations engineers on network issues, and participate in on-call rotation and out-of-hours change windows as required.
* Identify and act upon opportunities for continuous improvement to reduce risk, optimise efficiency and capacity, and improve standards.
* Build knowledge of cloud networking and network automation, and share what you learn with the team.

**Basic Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience (5+ years) in enterprise networking, including hands-on experience working in a cloud environment.
* Practical hands-on experience with network automation, including Terraform and Python, and familiarity with version control using Git.
* Hands-on cloud networking experience in at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, with working knowledge of a second.
* Working experience with cloud networking services such as VPC, subnets, security groups, route tables, Transit Gateway, Route 53 and ELBs, or their Azure and GCP equivalents.
* Good knowledge of networking standards, protocols and technologies, including routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, VPNs, DNS and load balancing.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer (Network Routing/Switching Engineer)
jobs.description:
Join us as an Infrastructure Engineer
  
  

* You’ll engineer infrastructure technology for public and private cloud environments, complying with security, resilience, sustainability, and operational requirements with observability and guardrails built in
* You’ll also use automation to provide testing and a route to live for the product, working with customers to help them use our products appropriately through a users’ CI or CD pipeline
* This is a chance to work with colleagues across the bank to share engineering best practices, allowing you to expand your network and gain exposure for you and your work
* We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll contribute to and manage the selection, creation and maintenance of technologies required to meet the needs of our customers, strategic targets and architecture outcomes, along with developing products using modern engineering practices and tools.
  
  
We’ll look to you to collaborate with stakeholders to inform product roadmaps, detailing lifecycles of the technology from new products through to end of support and retirement. You’ll also support engineered products and respond to user feedback, new feature requests and resolve production issues wanted by the Product Owner.
  
  
**Additionally, You’ll**

* Develop technical skills through continuous learning and development
* Work within a team to design intuitive, self-service infrastructure products
* Contribute to the delivery of infrastructure as code solutions
* Work with users to help use our products and gain feedback
* Provide operational support for pattern or product related issues
* Generate innovative ideas and drive the delivery of those through product features

The skills you'll need
  
  
To thrive in this role, you’ll have experience in software development or automation scripting such as Python or Shell, with an understanding of the software development lifecycle. You’ll also have experience in utilizing modern infrastructure as code via tooling.
  
  
We’ll expect you to bring a good understanding of Agile working practices and toolsets with the ability to relate everyday work to the vision of the feature team, platform and domain.
  
  
**Furthermore, You’ll Need**

* Minimum seven years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure environments
* Strong experience with Cisco Catalyst, Nexus and Arista platforms
* Good knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies including STP, OSPF, BGP, VLANs, VXLAN and EVPN
* Experience supporting Arista data centre fabric environments
* Strong troubleshooting skills across routing, switching, and WAN technologies
* Experience supporting VPN, network security and segmentation solutions
* Exposure to network automation tools such as Ansible, Python or similar technologies
* Experience working in both operational support and infrastructure project delivery environments
* Ability to work effectively during major incidents and within high-pressure situations
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working within Agile and ITIL-based delivery models
* Cisco CCNP or Arista certifications preferred

jobs.title: Systems/Software Engineer – SONiC Development
jobs.description:
Work on next-generation networking platforms and SONiC network operating systems. As a Platforms Developer at Talentica, you’ll build and enhance high-performance network switching and platform software, solving complex system-level engineering challenges involving Linux, hardware integration, embedded systems, and networking.

### **What You'll Own**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain features for the SONiC network operating system.
* Develop and debug system software using C, C++, Python, or Go.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel, device driver, and platform-level issues.
* Work on hardware interfaces, system bring-up, and embedded platform software.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers and QA teams for end-to-end product development.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical documentation.
* Improve system performance, reliability, and overall product quality.

### **What We Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* Strong programming experience in C, C++, Python, or Go.
* Good understanding of Linux OS, Linux Kernel, and system-level debugging.
* Experience with data structures, object-oriented programming, and software design.
* Hands-on experience in Linux device drivers, system bring-up, or embedded systems.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, Ethernet, and system software development.
* Experience working with large codebases and debugging complex system-level issues.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience with SONiC network operating system.
* Exposure to Embedded Linux and platform software development.
* Knowledge of networking protocols, Ethernet switching, routing, and packet forwarding.
* Familiarity with hardware interfaces such as PCIe, SPI, I2C, and MDIO.
* Experience with FPGA, CPLD, and Flash drivers.
* Knowledge of Ethernet technologies (1G to 400G/800G), MACsec, PHY, and SerDes.
* Experience with SFP, QSFP, QDD, and OSFP optics.
* Exposure to scripting and DevOps practices.

### **Why It's Worth Your Time**

* Become an AI-Native Engineer and build next-generation intelligent products.
* Work on challenging product engineering problems instead of support projects.
* Collaborate with innovative startups and global product companies.
* Gain exposure to modern technologies, AI ecosystems, and evolving engineering practices.

With a strong engineering team and a culture focused on learning, ownership, and technical excellence, Talentica offers opportunities to work on challenging product development initiatives, explore emerging technologies, and build next-generation software solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Network Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA’s Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments.
* Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery.
* Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps.
* Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features.
* Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution.
* Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery.
* Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery.
* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python.
* Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery.
* Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus.
* Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery.
* Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades.
* Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

You own the platform every part of ParamAIQ is built on. The app, the AI features, the integrations for law firms: all of it runs through the API and services layer you build. When a lawyer trusts us with a confidential matter and expects it to be fast, correct, and private, your systems are what make that true.

This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You make the architectural calls, and you write the code that matters most. In legal software a bug is not cosmetic: it is a confidential matter exposed or a filing that fails, so we want senior people who get the foundations right the first time.

**What You'll Own**

* The product API and services layer: The architecture and the code.
* AI feature systems: Long-running, sometimes-failing operations that still feel fast and reliable to a lawyer under deadline.
* Multi-tenant isolation: Strong enough that one firm's matters are provably invisible to another. In legal, a cross-tenant leak is the worst thing that can happen.
* Data models for legal work: Matters, drafts, versions, and audit trails that stay coherent as the product grows.
* Reliability, performance, and cost: As the system scales.
* The rest of the product surface: Authentication, billing, uploads, exports, and notifications.

**The Hard Problems You'll Take On**

* Making unreliable, slow AI operations feel dependable: Model calls fail, time out, and cost money. The orchestration, idempotency, and graceful degradation that hide this from a lawyer is a real systems problem.
* Isolation you can prove: Not just separating tenants, but demonstrating and testing that separation across every path in the product.
* Getting the foundations right early: The data models, contracts, and access control you set now are the hardest to change later, and the most expensive to get wrong once real client data is flowing.

**What You Bring**

* 4+ years of backend engineering in Python, with a framework like FastAPI, Django, or Flask
* You design systems, not just features: you reason about scale, reliability, cost, and failure, and you defend your calls
* You've built multi-tenant SaaS with real data isolation between customers
* Strong API and service design: contracts, versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, backpressure
* Solid PostgreSQL: schema, indexing, transactions, performance
* Real command of auth: OAuth, OIDC, JWT, sessions, RBAC
* You write careful code and test the paths that matter, because you know what a mistake costs here
* Ready to work from our Mumbai office, full-time

**Bonus Points**

* 0-to-1 and early scale: you've taken a system from first version to real load and know what breaks first
* Performance and reliability work: profiling, load testing, and finding the failure before it reaches a user
* Async and background job systems (Celery, RQ) at scale
* Payments and billing systems (Razorpay, Stripe, or similar) and their failure modes
* Legal-tech, regtech, fintech, healthtech, or another regulated, trust-sensitive domain
* DPDPA, Indian data residency, and security practice

**What You Get**

* Real ownership of the platform and the architectural calls behind it, from day one
* The chance to get the foundations right on a product handling confidential legal matters
* Work shoulder to shoulder with practising lawyers on a product built for real legal work

**Location:** Pune, India. This role is based out of our Baner office.  
  
**What we are building**

* We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself.
* No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed.
* Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part.
* The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?
* That is the job.

  

**What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo:**

* Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
* Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
* Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
* Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
* Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
* Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions

* Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
* Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
* Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
* Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
* Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.

  

**Candidate Persona:**

* Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.

jobs.description:
Role Overview :

We are seeking a skilled Network Security Engineer to design, deploy, and manage our cloud security infrastructure using Cisco Umbrella. In this role, you will be the primary subject matter expert responsible for protecting our global workforce from internet-based threats. You will ensure secure web gateway connectivity, DNS-layer protection, and cloud access security broker (CASB) policies are seamlessly integrated into our network.

Key Responsibilities :

- Deployment & Architecture : Design, configure, and deploy Cisco Umbrella across corporate networks, roaming devices, and remote branch offices (SD-WAN integration).

- Policy Management : Create, maintain, and optimize DNS-layer security policies, Secure Web Gateway (SWG) rules, content filtering, and SSL decryption exceptions.

- Threat Mitigation : Analyze Cisco Umbrella security reports, identify compromised endpoints, and mitigate malware, ransomware, botnets, and phishing attempts.

- Integrations : Connect Cisco Umbrella with existing security tools, including SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar), Cisco Secure Endpoint (AMP), and Active Directory for identity-based policies.

- Cloud Security (CASB) : Utilize Cloud Access Security Broker features to discover shadow IT, control cloud application usage, and enforce data loss prevention (DLP) strategies.

- Troubleshooting : Diagnose and resolve complex DNS routing, network latency, VPN conflict, and certificate deployment issues related to the Umbrella roaming client.

- Monitoring & Reporting : Build automated threat dashboards and deliver regular security posture reports to senior leadership.

Technical Skills :

- Primary Tool : Hands-on experience with Cisco Umbrella (Multi-org console, Roaming Computers, Virtual Appliances, and AnyConnect integration).

- Networking Protocol : Deep understanding of DNS (records, routing, Anycast), DHCP, TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and SSL/TLS decryption.

- Security Infrastructure : Knowledge of Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) architecture, and Proxy servers.

- Identity Management : Experience linking security policies with Active Directory (AD), Azure AD/Entra ID, or Okta.

- Other Skills : Strong analytical mind with a proactive approach to threat hunting. Excellent technical documentation and communication skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure during security incidents.

Qualifications & Experience :

- Experience : 3 - 6 years of dedicated experience in Network Security or Cloud Security engineering.

- Education : Bachelors degree in computer science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

- Certifications (Preferred) : Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Securing the Web with Cisco Umbrella (300-725 SWSA), CompTIA Security+, CEH.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
Arista Networks is looking for world-class software engineers to join our IP Routing Protocols development team. As a core member of the IP Routing Protocols team, you will be part of a fast paced, high caliber team building routing protocol software to run the world's largest data center networks. Your software will be a key component of Arista's Extensible Operating System (EOS), Arista's unique, Linux-based network operating system that runs on all of Arista's data center networking products.
  
  
The Routing Protocols team is responsible for all aspects of the development and delivery of our routing protocol software. You will work with your fellow engineers and members of the marketing team to gather functional and technical requirements for upcoming projects.
